Kat Macdonald is a London-based sound and performance artist exploring collective practice and public space through technology, transmission and alternative pedagogies. She is the founder of the London Community Laptop Orchestra and a long time member of the Design And Performance Lab (DAP Lab). Her work has been shown internationally at festivals such as DRHA, Lumbung Radio Assembly, Intimidades Públicas (ICNOVA), The World Transformed, and more.
